snippet.title: Funorbit - Trailer August 2026
snippet.description:
Funorbit is a physics-based pixel art space survival simulation where you navigate a vast, procedurally generated universe using realistic orbital mechanics. Master acceleration, deceleration, and gravitational forces to explore planets, moons, and drifting meteoroids, each with unique motion and spin. Collide with meteoroids to break them into pieces, evade cosmic dangers, and use your HUD to track real-time speed, distances, and directions as you travel through deep space.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3554220/Funorbit/
